guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以RO 回收率、鹽收支、驅動力與正規化診斷為主線，從進水分析與相容性、流股與回收率、截鹽率與濃度基準、濃水鹽質量閉合進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops ro recovery, salt balance, driving force and normalized diagnosis through ten connected units, beginning with feed analysis and compatibility, streams and recovery, rejection and concentration basis, concentrate salt balance. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「進水分析與相容性」的觀測點。採進水、產水、濃水並記錄溫度及各離子分析。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「流股與回收率」的觀測點。同步記錄進水、透過、濃水三支流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「截鹽率與濃度基準」的觀測點。分析進水與透過水並保留溫度、採樣時間。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「濃水鹽質量閉合」的觀測點。比對三股流量與分析濃度，查收支殘差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「滲透壓與淨驅動力」的觀測點。同時量鹽度、溫度與壓力，避免只靠加壓解釋產水。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「段間濃縮與結垢」的觀測點。比較進水、濃水離子質量平衡與飽和指數，不只比電導率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「壓力、功率與能源」的觀測點。同步記錄流量、壓差與電功率，核對量測邊界。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「正規化趨勢與診斷」的觀測點。用同一膜型的核准正規化方法，保留原始溫壓與鹽度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「清洗恢復與完整性」的觀測點。將恢復通量與截留、壓差一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「成品水、濃水與全鏈驗證」的觀測點。比對三股流量與分析濃度，查收支殘差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed analysis and compatibility. Sample feed, permeate and concentrate with temperature and ion analyses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for streams and recovery. Record feed, permeate and concentrate flow simultaneously. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rejection and concentration basis. Analyze feed/permeate and retain temperature and timing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for concentrate salt balance. Compare all three flows/concentrations and inspect balance residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for osmotic pressure and net driving force. Measure salinity, temperature and pressure rather than attributing production only to pressure. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for interstage concentration and scaling. Compare feed/concentrate ion balances and saturation indices, not conductivity alone. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for pressure, power and energy. Synchronize flow, pressure difference and electrical power and check measurement boundaries. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for normalized trends and diagnosis. Use the approved normalization method for that membrane type and retain raw temperature, pressure and salinity. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cleaning recovery and integrity. Compare recovered flux with rejection and pressure loss. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for product, concentrate and whole-chain verification. Compare all three flows/concentrations and inspect balance residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 只用總鹽度挑選所有前處理。診斷與介入：補做離子分析及流量配對，不將電導率無條件換成鹽質量。
回收率被當作鹽去除率。診斷與介入：重新關閉三流股水量，檢查濃水條件與後段風險。
以電導率比值當每個離子的精確截留率。診斷與介入：確認同成分及同溫基準，將鹽透過和水回收率分開。
直接把回收率倒數當實際濃水濃度。診斷與介入：將三流股流量與離子分析配對，列出沉澱或漏算流股。
進水鹽度升高時只追查機械故障。診斷與介入：更新壓差和鹽度對應的滲透壓差，再分析通量變化。
以平均濃水濃度忽略局部膜面高濃度。診斷與介入：改用各離子質量與飽和分析，另估膜面濃差極化。
用水力功率當全廠電表值。診斷與介入：以實測壓差、流量及電表核對效率，分列附屬與回收能源。
直接比冬夏原始產水量判定老化。診斷與介入：依膜型核准方法完整正規化，保存原始溫度、壓力與鹽度。
清洗後產水增加但截鹽率變差仍宣稱成功。診斷與介入：把恢復通透率與截留或完整性證據一起判讀。
只報回收率與電導率而漏掉穩定性及濃水管理。診斷與介入：將三流股流量與離子分析配對，列出沉澱或漏算流股。
pitfallsEn: Total salinity alone determines all pretreatment. Diagnostic response: Add ion analysis and matched flow, avoiding unconditional conductivity-to-salt conversion.
Recovery is mistaken for salt rejection. Diagnostic response: Reclose the three-stream water balance and check concentrate/downstream conditions.
Conductivity ratio is treated as exact rejection for every ion. Diagnostic response: Check same-species/temperature bases and separate salt passage from water recovery.
Inverse recovery is used directly as concentrate concentration. Diagnostic response: Pair three-stream flows/ion analysis and list precipitation or omitted streams.
Only mechanical faults are investigated when feed salinity rises. Diagnostic response: Update hydraulic/osmotic pressure differences before interpreting flux changes.
Average concentrate concentration hides higher membrane-surface values. Diagnostic response: Use ion balances/saturation analysis and separately estimate membrane-surface polarization.
Hydraulic power is treated as plant electricity consumption. Diagnostic response: Check efficiency with measured pressure, flow and power, separating auxiliaries and recovered energy.
Raw summer/winter output is compared to diagnose aging. Diagnostic response: Normalize fully using the membrane-approved method and retain raw temperature, pressure and salinity.
Higher output after cleaning is celebrated despite worse rejection. Diagnostic response: Interpret recovered permeability alongside rejection or integrity evidence.
Recovery and conductivity are reported while stability and concentrate management are omitted. Diagnostic response: Pair three-stream flows/ion analysis and list precipitation or omitted streams.

courses.connection: 本課以RO 回收率、鹽收支、驅動力與正規化診斷為主線，從進水分析與相容性、流股與回收率、截鹽率與濃度基準、濃水鹽質量閉合進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops ro recovery, salt balance, driving force and normalized diagnosis through ten connected units, beginning with feed analysis and compatibility, streams and recovery, rejection and concentration basis, concentrate salt balance. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
